stories.title: Admin Settings Page
stories.description: Create settings page with navigation tabs for admin-only configuration.
acceptance_criteria: New /settings route accessible only to admin role
Settings page with tabs: Users, Categories, Tags
Navigation link in header for admin users
Redirect non-admin users to dashboard

stories.title: User Management
stories.description: Admin can view, add, edit, and deactivate users.
acceptance_criteria: List all users with name, role, status
Add new user form (name, password, role)
Edit user (name, role)
Reset user password
Deactivate/reactivate user toggle

stories.title: Category Management
stories.description: Admin can add, edit, reorder, and delete menu categories.
acceptance_criteria: List all categories with sort order
Add new category
Edit category name
Delete category (only if no menus use it)
Drag to reorder categories

stories.title: Tag Management
stories.description: Admin can add, edit, and delete menu tags with colors.
acceptance_criteria: List all tags with color preview
Add new tag with name and color picker
Edit tag name and color
Delete tag (only if no menus use it)

stories.title: Export Menu History
stories.description: Export version history for a menu as CSV.
acceptance_criteria: Export button on menu detail page
CSV includes: version label, status, date, uploader, reason, summary
Download triggers browser file save
Filename includes menu name and date

stories.title: Export Activity Log
stories.description: Export filtered activity log as CSV.
acceptance_criteria: Export button on activity page
CSV includes: date, user, action, target, details
Export respects current filters
Filename includes date range
